note: In the Latin text, the last line lacks a parallelism; Geoltrain (1987) restores it on the basis of the Ethiopic text: “et je ne suis pas entré au paradis.”
The Latin has _in inferno promptuaria animarum_; Geoltrain translates this on the basis of the Ethiopic text as if the Latin had _infernum et promptuaria animarum._
